name: EWC Elite Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The federation's top singles title, first won in a four-man tournament at the debut supercard and still held at the record's own end.

name: EWC Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: The federation's number-two singles title, billed at launch as the Midwest Championship, first won in a ladder match at the debut supercard.

name: EWC Television Championship
epitaph: Defended weekly on the federation's own house show, first won in a Survival of the Fittest match at its second pay-per-view.

name: EWC Skinnyweight Championship
epitaph: The federation's cruiserweight-style title, decided by an eight-man tournament at its second pay-per-view.

name: EWC Elite Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Won by the Natural Born Killaz over two other teams at the federation's first pay-per-view and held through the record's own end.
